posts.name: Alsona
posts.tagline: AI agents that turn buying signals into booked sales calls
posts.description: 95% of prospects aren't ready to buy when you reach out. Alsona finds the ones showing buying intent right now. It tracks 32+ signals across hiring, funding, tech changes, reviews, ad spend, and more, then scores companies against your ICP and explains why they're worth contacting. AI agents turn those signals into personalized LinkedIn and email outreach, helping you start conversations while the buying window is open. Alsona helps you book calls directly with the 5% who is ready to buy today.

posts.name: Maxma
posts.tagline: The 24/7 AI teammate that scales your paid ad performance
posts.description: Maxma is the AI platform that 10Xs your human marketers. It does the end-to-end work of paid advertising, from analyzing performance, creating ads and landing pages, and launching and optimizing campaigns across channels, to managing tracking and reporting. Working like a teammate in Slack, on demand or proactively 24/7, it proposes changes for approval and drives measurable, incremental growth across Google, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, ChatGPT Ads, and more. So lean teams can grow without limits.

posts.name: Latch.ai
posts.tagline: Automate complex accounting work without a single prompt
posts.description: Latch is built for accountants buried in click-heavy close work. Instead of writing prompts, you do a task on screen and talk it through, including the parts no SOP captures: the three-day matching window, the rate you always override. Latch asks about the exceptions, then builds a sidekick that runs the task the same way every time, right in the tools you already use. When something doesn't fit, it stops and asks you. Every step is logged for review.

posts.name: Opal Reader
posts.tagline: Read PDFs and EPUBs on iPhone Duo
posts.description: Opal Reader is a PDF and EPUB reader with a notebook beside the page. On iPhone Duo, unfold to read your book and your notes together, then fold it closed and keep reading in a compact view with your place saved. Also available on iPhone and iPad.

posts.name: TK by Medium
posts.tagline: An agentic notebook to build your best thinking
posts.description: What if every thought had the chance to become something extraordinary? Meet TK, the agentic notebook by Medium. Capture every spark, from shower thoughts to forgotten notes. With AI right where you write, connect the dots, surface new possibilities, and compound what you know without breaking your flow. Then turn your thinking into writing that’s unmistakably yours. With built-in community and an MCP server that connects to your favorite LLMs and AI tools.

posts.name: Seldon
posts.tagline: Behavioral QA agents that use your product like customers do
posts.description: Find the tests you didn’t know to write. Tell Wren what should work in plain English. Its QA agents try the paths your customers take, like going back to change an address halfway through checkout or retrying a failed payment. When something breaks, you get a replay and the steps to reproduce the bug. First 10 runs free.

posts.name: Lottie AI
posts.tagline: Editable vector animations from a text prompt
posts.description: Motion generated as editable vector animation, built with builders in mind. Get a lightweight Lottie you can recolor, restyle and resize without regenerating, with custom controls for every animation. Add hover and click interactions with a simple prompt. Start with Turbo for quick ideas, or switch to Quality when you have a solid plan. No motion-design skills needed. Export to dotLottie, JSON, GIF, video and more.

posts.name: Co-Review
posts.tagline: Read the whole repository with the agent that built it
posts.description: Agent-built code works but stops feeling like yours. Co-Review opens the whole repository as a review: comment on a line, file or folder, ask why, and the agent answers from the code. Also reviews diffs, PRs and designs. Free, open source, no telemetry.

posts.name: ChromePing
posts.tagline: Talk to anyone by phone, in a language you don't speak
posts.description: Move somewhere you don't speak the language and the phone becomes a wall — the immigration office, your bank, a landlord, a clinic, even ordering food. The usual fix is bringing a human translator, if you can find one. ChromePing lets you call any real phone number — mobile or landline, anywhere — from your browser. No app to install, yours or theirs. The call is translated live, both ways, with captions. Whoever you call just answers their normal phone. Pay as you go, no subscription.

posts.name: Ember
posts.tagline: Free, open-source Slack you host on Cloudflare in one click
posts.description: Open Source Slack and Campfire inspired chat with one click deploy to Cloudflare. Slack-compatible payloads, AI assistant, media attachments, all built-in and hosted for $0 on Cloudflare free tiers.

posts.name: Coffee
posts.tagline: A quiet Markdown editor for Mac, with sums in your notes
posts.description: Coffee is a native Mac Markdown editor. Your notes stay plain Markdown files in a folder you choose. Answers to sums appear beside the line, maths and Mermaid diagrams are drawn natively, and you review every change an AI tool makes to a note. 14 days free.

posts.name: MuJoCo 4
posts.tagline: A physics engine for robots with its own studio
posts.description: MuJoCo 4 is a major update to Google DeepMind's open-source physics engine. It adds a modular 3D Studio, improved deformable-body simulation, and better handling of fast collisions. Explore models in your browser or build custom viewers.

posts.name: SideKick By Open
posts.tagline: “Claude, but for your product” is here.
posts.description: Make your product agentic in one click. Sidekick puts an AI agent inside your own product. Customers say what they need in one sentence and Sidekick does the work, long-horizon tasks, reports, actions, even navigating the UI for them. It's MCP-compatible, so it connects to the tools they already use. Sidekick is connected to the main Open platform, a full-stack customer communications engine: the same engine behind AI customer support and Open for Sales, now inside your product.

posts.name: AppuBot
posts.tagline: Grok Bot alternative that runs on your AI, completely free
posts.description: AI teammates you hand real work to. They use the apps on your Mac or PC like you do, while you watch or take over, and come back with it done. Runs on the AI plan you already have, so the app is free. AppuBot Cloud keeps them working 24/7 from $19/mo.

posts.name: Almanzor
posts.tagline: Ask AI + MCP server for your docs, with cited answers
posts.description: Paste your docs URL and get an assistant that answers from your pages, cites its source and says when it doesn't know. Add it with one script tag, share a link, or let coding agents search your docs through a hosted MCP server.

posts.name: Rodeo
posts.tagline: A Notion alternative with AI meeting notes on the free plan
posts.description: Rodeo is a workspace for docs, wikis and databases your team edits together in real time. AI meeting notes come with every plan, including Free: transcript, summary, decisions and tasks. Plus Ask AI, an AI canvas and a built-in MCP server. Imports Notion.

posts.name: AppTraction
posts.tagline: Supercharge Apple App Store analytics
posts.description: AppTraction is a native Mac app that makes App Store Connect make sense. Your sales, analytics, ratings, and reviews live on your Mac and appear instantly. It monitors your apps, flags problems, trends, and milestones, and writes weekly, monthly, and annual reports. Its AI evaluates your listing and helps fix it, and you can chat about any chart or report. It’s primed with Apple’s own ASO advice and uses your existing Claude or Codex subscription. Your data is stored only on your Mac.

posts.name: Quillo
posts.tagline: Listen to any PDF in a natural voice, then ask Quillo Ai
posts.description: Quillo reads PDFs, Word files, photos and web pages aloud in a natural voice and highlights each sentence. Quillo Ai answers questions about your documents. Merge, compress, sign, scan and convert for free on Android, iPhone and the web.

posts.name: ForAgent
posts.tagline: Private phone numbers so AI agents can call each other
posts.description: ForAgent gives your AI agents private phone numbers so they can talk to each other, on your own computers or with other people. Handle calls in our app, or right inside your AI with the plugin. You choose who gets through.

posts.name: gitmanual
posts.tagline: See if a GitHub repo runs on your OS, and how to set it up
posts.description: Know if a GitHub project will run on your computer before you clone it. Paste any repo link and get its setup manual: a yes/no verdict for macOS, Windows or Linux, everything you need to install, and the exact steps, or one setup script. It reads the repo's own files, no AI guessing, and links to the maintainers' guide when unsure. Swap "hub" for "manual" in any GitHub URL, use the Chrome extension, or the MCP server for AI assistants. Works on private repos. Free and open source.

posts.name: ZUS
posts.tagline: AI-native IDE: agents code with human review
posts.description: ZUS is a desktop IDE with an AI agent built in. The agent reads your codebase, plans, edits and runs commands within the permissions you grant. You read every diff before keeping it, undo what it got wrong, and see each subagent's tool calls in Team Inspector. Your project index and context stay on your machine, and you connect your own AI provider. Built on Tauri 2 and Rust, with a ~20 MB Windows installer. Runs on Windows, macOS (Apple Silicon) and Linux.

posts.name: Inspo by Context.dev
posts.tagline: Real website inspiration for your coding agent
posts.description: Describe the website you want to build, find real design references, and turn your picks into a prompt for your coding agent. Use Inspo in your browser or add it to your agent through MCP. Free, with no API key needed.

posts.name: Clive
posts.tagline: Let Claude and other AIs set your iPhone alarms
posts.description: A lot of us run our lives with alarms, but setting them one at a time is a hassle. With Clive, you can ask Claude to set them for you, even from your calendar, through Apple's AlarmKit. In the app, Clive walks to the right instrument and plays it.

posts.name: Obsiva
posts.tagline: Turn site pics + voice notes into a PDF inspection report
posts.description: Obsiva turns site photos and voice notes into a professional PDF inspection report, on your phone, before you leave the site. Snap photos, mark the issue, talk. AI writes each finding (description, severity, responsible party, action) and the executive summary. On the next visit, track what's still open with before/after photos. Works offline. Bilingual reports (English/Spanish). Free on Android; Pro adds unlimited reports, cloud backup and your logo.

posts.name: Dover Startup Jobs
posts.tagline: Where great startups meet great candidates
posts.description: Dover Startup Jobs helps venture-backed startups attract great candidates for free. Reach people who want to work at startups, post jobs in any region, publish in one click, and manage every applicant in one place.

posts.name: Operum
posts.tagline: Your AI product team, with expert workflows built in
posts.description: Build and launch software without managing AI agents. The Operum desktop app gives founders and developers a coordinated AI product team: PM, Architect, Engineer, Tester, Marketing, Community. Describe your goal in chat; agents plan, build in your GitHub repo, independently test changes, and help you launch. Expert workflows and human approvals are built in, with optional auto-merge. Use Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex. Engines change; your team stays. Free plan + 14-day Premium trial. No card.

posts.name: OpenVibe
posts.tagline: A canvas of real terminals for your AI coding agents
posts.description: Desktop app that runs your AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Aider and more) in real terminals on an infinite canvas. Group them into teams, brief a team in one line, review their changes, and hand a big task to an orchestrator. Windows, MIT.

posts.name: Kettle
posts.tagline: The helper in your family group chat
posts.description: Kettle is a helper in your family's group chat. There's no app and nothing to set up: text it on its own, or start a group message with "Kettle." It remembers the details you tell it, plans dinners around your week, builds a grocery cart for you to review and check out, and sends group or private reminders plus a short morning brief. Getting started: text hi, each person texts once so it knows who's who, then add Kettle to the group. 7 days free, then $19 a month for the whole family.

posts.name: TOWeb 15
posts.tagline: Rewritten as a native Mac & Windows app, with AI and MCP
posts.description: TOWeb 15 is a complete rewrite of our 20-year-old desktop website builder. It is now a native app for Mac (Apple Silicon and Intel) and Windows that builds fast, accessible websites and online stores without code. New: write directly on the page, 50 complete styles in light and dark, a built-in AI assistant (local or cloud), and in the Studio edition your own AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini) can drive TOWeb through MCP. Works offline, publishes to any host, no subscription.

posts.name: Daytwo
posts.tagline: Let your team change your custom site without touching code
posts.description: Ask for a new landing page, a pricing plan or a signup form, and Daytwo builds it on your Next.js or Astro site from your own brand and components. It waits in a private draft until someone on your team approves it. Publishing is a normal commit to your GitHub repo, your developers keep working as usual, and it runs on your own Claude plan. Stop using Daytwo and your site keeps running exactly as it is.

posts.name: CollaboTokyo
posts.tagline: Explore a virtual Tokyo to network, market, and collaborate
posts.description: What if networking felt more like exploring a city than scrolling through a feed? CollaboTokyo is a virtual Tokyo where creators, builders, entrepreneurs, and brands from around the world meet, discover projects, and collaborate. The city is broken up into districts & neighborhoods each with its own category/topic so you can explore and share project, work, and ideas with people in the same niche. Explore the city. Meet people. Make things happen.

posts.name: Willder
posts.tagline: The context layer that syncs your apps, agents and teams
posts.description: A context layer that syncs your apps, agents and teams. Each agent gets its own scoped, revocable token; what one agent writes, the others read on their next call; connectors bring your apps in under the same rules (measured on GitHub so far). The engine is MIT and self-hostable.

posts.name: MoreFrame
posts.tagline: Dual-screen recording and editing for Mac and Windows
posts.description: Record your screen and a second window, add 500+ motion graphics, captions and Smart Zoom, or let any AI edit over MCP. Free for Mac and Windows, no watermark.

posts.name: Gesso
posts.tagline: Ask ChatGPT or Claude to design, then edit every layer
posts.description: Connect Gesso to ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or any agent and ask for a website, a deck or a poster. It builds live on your canvas in real HTML and CSS layers you can drag, restyle and export. Free to try on Mac.

posts.name: QuotedPart
posts.tagline: AI quoting for CNC and sheet metal job shops
posts.description: QuotedPart reads the quote request and its files, then prices every quantity on your own machines and rates in under a minute. An estimator checks it and sends the quote. $399/mo per shop, first 20 shops $199.

posts.name: Ownkube
posts.tagline: Deploy apps from your coding agent with one prompt
posts.description: Paste one line into Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, and your agent deploys the repo on Ownkube: the app, a managed Postgres and a cache, live on HTTPS. You sign in and approve the deploy. Apps bill per minute for what they use, so an idle app costs almost nothing. Credit you top up never expires. Bring your own cloud: when a customer wants your app in their own AWS account, you deploy the same app there with no rewrite, logs and metrics included.

posts.name: RunThru
posts.tagline: Video proof that your agent's pull request works
posts.description: Comment /runthru on a pull request. An agent uses the feature on your preview, films a narrated walkthrough, and a second model grades whether it works. Video and verdict land in the PR in 5 minutes, with a share link and a Slack post. Free: 5 videos a month.

posts.name: openring
posts.tagline: Open-source voice AI agents with no platform fee
posts.description: Self-hosted voice AI agents with a Vapi-compatible API. AI phone agents on Twilio, Telnyx, Plivo, Vonage or SIP, with your keys or 100% local and free (Whisper, Ollama, Kokoro). No per-minute platf...

posts.name: VeilCC
posts.tagline: Ship code AI can't reverse engineer
posts.description: Ship code AI can't reverse-engineer. VeilCC hardens it with AI-resistant obfuscation and seals your key logic, so attackers can't crack, clone, or cheat your game or app.

posts.name: Kata Send
posts.tagline: Cold email infrastructure for AI agents
posts.description: Kata Send lets your AI agent run cold email. One command from Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor: Kata checks the addresses, writes the emails, sends from warmed inboxes and follows up in the same thread. It reads replies, clicks and sales, then sends more of the version that sells. Daily caps and auto pause protect deliverability. Start with no domains at $0.04 per email, or connect your own inboxes from $29 a month. $10 free to start.

posts.name: Kumiko
posts.tagline: AI window manager for ultrawide and big-screen Macs
posts.description: Kumiko is an AI powered Mac window manager for ultrawide and big monitors. Snap windows with ⌃⌥ and the arrow keys, pick one of six layouts that fit your screen, or just say what you are working on and Kumiko arranges every window.

posts.name: CloakPane
posts.tagline: A Mac browser that stays out of your screen shares
posts.description: CloakPane is a private Mac browser hidden from screenshots, screen recordings and screen sharing. Keep your bank or password manager open on a call; the others see only what's behind the window. Free to use as a browser, Pro from $2.99 a month.

posts.name: Tokens by UI Colors
posts.tagline: Build your product’s visual language with design tokens
posts.description: Tokens is a visual playground for creating a unique visual language for your digital product. Explore colors, typography, spacing, radius, and shadows with simple controls, then fine-tune every detail with advanced customization options. Tokens uses a reusable system of primitive and semantic design tokens to help keep your interfaces consistent across websites, SaaS products, and apps, whether built by humans or AI agents. Export it as CSS variables or a DESIGN.md file.

posts.name: HitPay Agentic Discovery
posts.tagline: Make your store findable and buyable by AI agents
posts.description: Agentic Discovery lets any AI assistant find and recommend what you sell on HitPay: product and price and a Checkout with HitPay button in chat. Each store gets its own MCP server. Free to switch on; standard fees when you sell.

posts.name: Billing MCP By SubscriptionFlow
posts.tagline: Open Source AI Agent to Run Your Subscription Billing
posts.description: Monetize your AI apps and assistants down to the single action, using Stripe, PayPal, Authorize.net and other major payment gateways. With the SubscriptionFlow MCP billing plugin, bill customers per question answered, task completed, or custom action. Offer prepaid credit wallets or post-billing with real-time balance checks that eliminate overspending. Set dynamic usage rates, automate metering, and protect margins, turning AI consumption into automated revenue.

posts.name: LotusQ
posts.tagline: Talk instead of type, in any app
posts.description: LotusQ is now on iPhone. Add the keyboard, tap Start and talk: your words are typed into any app, in 78 languages, or translated as you speak. 7 days of everything, then Free: 2,000 words a week. Also on Mac, Windows and Linux.

posts.name: FigSchema
posts.tagline: Design database schemas right in FigJam
posts.description: FigSchema turns FigJam into a database schema designer. Table cards with typed columns and PK/FK badges, relationships anchored to columns that follow every move, and export to SQL, DBML or docs. Paste CREATE TABLE statements and the diagram builds itself.

posts.name: Nadhif
posts.tagline: Check Mac, server and website security
posts.description: Check Mac security settings, audit Debian/Ubuntu servers over read-only SSH, and inspect websites you own after DNS verification. Then clear developer clutter and use the free cleaner with 7-day restore for most items. Developer and Security tools: about $33 for a lifetime license, no subscription, 7-day trial. macOS 15+, Apple silicon, ~12 MB.

posts.name: Levo
posts.tagline: Your AI agent finds what's safe to delete on your Mac
posts.description: Levo lives in your menubar and watches disk, memory, CPU and GPU. When space runs low, your own AI agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or any CLI) checks what's filling your Mac, even System Data. You tick what goes, and Levo cleans it up.

posts.name: Wipecraft
posts.tagline: Mac System Data cleaner with on-device AI mode
posts.description: macOS shows System Data as one number. Wipecraft lists what is in it, and in the rest of the disk, with each item's size and what removing it does. It knows what Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Xcode, simulators and Docker leave behind, and locks work in progress. Ask Overview a question with AI mode, which runs on your Mac. Safe cleanup can run on a schedule. Nothing comes selected; what does not rebuild itself goes to Quarantine for 30 days. Scanning is free; cleaning is a one-time license.

posts.name: Recepto
posts.tagline: Find B2B buyers before they raise their hand
posts.description: Recepto watches public buying signals such as funding, hiring, tool switches and peers asking for recommendations, and scores each account 0–100 against your ICP with the source shown. It then finds the decision maker, verifies the contact and drafts an opener that cites the signal. First scored leads within 24 hours.

posts.name: InReality
posts.tagline: Capture photos and videos, prove they are real
posts.description: In a world increasingly filled with fake content, capture what matters, prove it’s real. InReality makes content verifiable as real from the moment of capture. Whether taking photos or recording videos, it captures authentication details at the source, tracks edits, and makes provenance transparent and verifiable. No guesswork. No blind trust. Just proof of where content came from and how it has changed. Built for photographers, journalists, creators, and anyone with something real to show.

posts.name: Sell Personal Agents with Pickaxe
posts.tagline: Turn agents into products
posts.description: Our latest Pickaxe release lets you build and sell always-on personal AI agents under your own brand. You can also sell your skills by adding them to agents customers pay to use. Connect your knowledge and tools, deploy wherever your customers work, and manage access through branded client portals. Flexible access groups and built-in monetization support subscriptions, one-time purchases, and usage credits.

posts.name: Slow Time Club
posts.tagline: Block distracting apps. Make time for life.
posts.description: An iPhone app blocker for the time you want back. Block distracting apps, schedule time away, or set daily limits. Choose soft or hard blocks. No account needed. Pay once for lifetime access.

posts.name: Vidyst Studio
posts.tagline: Live Streaming & Multistreaming App for Mac
posts.description: Stream, record and bring guests on from one Mac app. Go live on YouTube, Twitch, X and Instagram at once, wide for YouTube and tall for Shorts and Reels.

posts.name: Krumzi
posts.tagline: Your own graphic designer
posts.description: Tell Krumzi what you need in plain words: this week's posts, a carousel, a Reel, an event flyer. It designs each one from scratch in your brand and takes your feedback until it's right. Every part stays editable, and you can schedule to Instagram and Facebook.

posts.name: LaunchDay Kit
posts.tagline: Your whole product launch, done by Claude Code
posts.description: A Claude Code kit that makes your launch video, OG image, screenshots, copy, SEO and X plan, then submits your product to 77 verified free launch sites in your own Chrome. You only sign in and handle CAPTCHAs.

posts.name: Glaido
posts.tagline: Voice intelligence for every app you use
posts.description: Voice intelligence for Claude and Codex, wherever you work. Lightning-fast dictation and intelligent commands to summarise pages and videos. macOS, Windows 11 and Linux. ISO 27001 certified. GDPR compliant. Start free.

posts.name: HeyDonna
posts.tagline: AI transcript editor for digital court reporters
posts.description: HeyDonna is an AI transcript editor for digital court reporters and legal transcriptionists. It drafts, proofreads and formats depositions with tracked changes you accept or reject before exporting DOCX. 2,500 free credits to try.

posts.name: Corresso
posts.tagline: A shared support inbox that drafts replies a person sends
posts.description: Corresso is a shared inbox for small online stores. Customer email arrives with a reply drafted from your own policies and website, each fact citing its source. Rules in code hold a draft that offers a refund your documents don't allow. A person always reads it and presses Send: no auto-send, no bulk approve. Shopify orders sit beside each email. $75 a month for the whole team, 433 conversations included, 14-day free trial.

posts.name: Lemongraph
posts.tagline: Task manager for more focused workdays
posts.description: Personal task manager for people whose days are split between meetings and their inbox. We turn those conversations into action items before you have even moved on to the next thing. Each morning there is a focused list of what deserves your time today. And those routines you repeat every week? Hand them off once and we will take care of them.

posts.name: DatingProfile
posts.tagline: Realistic dating profile photos from one selfie
posts.description: Turn one selfie into realistic Tinder, Hinge and Bumble photos, with your face the same in every shot. 62 styles, about a minute per photo, one-time from $29, no subscription. Plus 9 free tools, like a photo rater and a bio writer, with no sign-up.

posts.name: Offline Support by CometChat
posts.tagline: Chat that keeps working when the network doesn’t
posts.description: CometChat’s Chat SDKs now work offline. Conversations load from the device, messages sent without a connection queue up and survive a restart, and missed changes sync back on reconnect. Off by default, on with one setting at init, with optional encryption for the local cache. Live in our JavaScript, Android, iOS, Flutter, and React Native SDKs.

posts.name: Notiqoo
posts.tagline: WhatsApp automation built exclusively for WooCommerce.
posts.description: The all-in-one WhatsApp platform built exclusively for WooCommerce that helps you automate WhatsApp notifications, recover abandoned carts, send broadcasts, verify COD orders, and chat with customers.

posts.name: Motion Fab
posts.tagline: Describe a video in chat, an AI agent animates it
posts.description: Shipping a product? Describe it in a chat and an AI agent makes its launch video: kinetic type, 3D, sound and voice-over, with your screenshots and footage. Live preview, edits in plain words, MP4 export. Free to try, no sign-up.

posts.name: MacMonitor
posts.tagline: Mac cleaner, file organizer and activity monitor in one
posts.description: MacMonitor is a native Mac app that shows what's filling your disk and cleans it safely. Clean System Data sorts it into safe to clean, worth a look, and managed by macOS. Smart Scan finds junk, build caches, AI models and idle apps in one pass. Organizer sorts messy folders, and Activity shows CPU, memory, disk and battery. You review everything first, cleanup goes to the Trash with Put Back, and nothing is uploaded. One-time purchase, macOS 14+. Try it in your browser: macmonitor.app/demo

posts.name: looplog
posts.tagline: Build better habits with private, on-device AI.
posts.description: Turn your goals into habits with on-device AI. Track progress, build routines, and stay consistent with a private, offline-first habit tracker for Android.

posts.name: ENOMOTIA
posts.tagline: A strategy game that isn't boring: taverns, fishing, war
posts.description: A multiplayer strategy game set in Ancient Greece, played in your browser, and it isn't boring. Build your city, join an alliance, go to war. Walk into the tavern, fish off the jetty, have AI carve your monument. On iPhone and Android too.

posts.name: Mimi Baby
posts.tagline: Capture every baby milestone in seconds
posts.description: Mimi Baby is the baby photo app for new parents who want to remember every moment without spending hours editing. From the pregnancy photo and the pregnancy announcement to the birth announcement, the monthly baby photo and the first birthday, choose a theme, take a photo and Mimi Baby adds the decorated numbers, filters and layout. Gender reveal ideas, baby milestone cards and baby shower ideas are all in one free app for iPhone and iPad, made in France by a mum.

posts.name: Dora
posts.tagline: The AI account manager for teams with clients
posts.description: Dora is the AI account manager for teams that do client work. An agentic client portal: Dora briefs every request and gets it signed off, and your team or your own AI agents do the work.

posts.name: Météohélie
posts.tagline: Weather, everywhere on Earth: any city, village or point
posts.description: Current weather, the next 7 days and 22 hour-by-hour charts for any place on Earth — a city, a village (no population threshold), coordinates, a tap on the map or your GPS. World map or 3D globe, OpenStreetMap, satellite, terrain and 3D buildings. Open-Meteo data shown honestly: the valid time is always displayed and a missing value stays a dash. French and English, no ads, no account, installs on your home screen. Free trial with 3 places, then €0.99 once.

posts.name: Toaster
posts.tagline: Play any song and watch it turn into live code
posts.description: Toaster listens to whatever is playing and writes it as live Strudel code: kick, clap, hats, bass line and chords, lit up as the song hits them, over scenes that move with it. Spotify search in the apps. Free, open source, in a browser or on Mac and Windows.

posts.name: Playbooks by Visme
posts.tagline: Your best deck, made for every customer
posts.description: Upload your best deck or template library. Playbooks rebuilds it in your exact design, then makes a new deck for every client in minutes. You decide what stays locked, what comes from your data and what AI writes. Free during the beta.

posts.name: ZuluCheck
posts.tagline: Checklists, weight & balance and landings for every pilot
posts.description: “Intuitive, practical, and clearly designed with pilots’ real-world needs in mind.” (Google Play) “Whether you’re tech-savvy or not, it’s incredibly simple.” (App Store) Checklists for hundreds of airplanes from the POH, a red Emergency button on every screen, weight and balance on the real envelope and landings counted on iPhone or Apple Watch. Offline, no account, 14 languages, iOS and Android. Free forever for two aircraft.

posts.name: BuildRuler
posts.tagline: Material & Cost Calculators for Home Projects
posts.description: Free calculators for home and yard projects: mulch, rock, dirt, concrete, asphalt, lumber, stairs, siding and BTU — plus 2026 cost estimators for roofs, slabs and driveways.

posts.name: AdiSaan
posts.tagline: The arena where people and AI answer the same question
posts.description: People answer in their own words. The models answer through a public endpoint and appear beside them under their own names — Claude, Gemini — never as a human voice. You choose whether yours stays private. With consent, the answers become a study of how people imagine the future. The models agree with each other. People don't. Ten questions, one open at a time. A living map shows where each answer came from. Free, in eleven languages.

posts.name: Fundlify Crowdfunding & Pre-order v2.5
posts.tagline: Crowdfunding and pre-orders, native to Shopify
posts.description: Built for Shopify launch platform to validate demand with $0 pre-launch (prelaunch) reservations, fund production via Shopify Checkout or deferred Draft Order invoices, customize drops in a live Design Studio, forecast SKU demand, and grow organically with 0%-commission Refer & Earn affiliates.

posts.description: Search every photo, screenshot and file on your iPhone in plain English, find the words inside them, and free up space with swipe cleanup, duplicates and video compression. Everything runs on your iPhone. No account, no uploads.

posts.description: Tourtify is booking software for tour, trek and activity operators: a professional booking website, online payments with deposits, and the tools to run every departure. No booking commission.

posts.description: Glide into your notch to instantly surface active applications, target windows, web spaces, and custom workflow shortcuts.

posts.tagline: Send your LLM only the context it needs
posts.description: Your LLM bill grows with context the model never needed: extra search results, raw tool output, old messages. Contextwaise trims it before each call. Prompt-cache safe, every removal logged, trimmed parts one call away. ~100 ms, any provider.

posts.description: Tourtify is booking software for tour, trek and activity operators: a professional booking website, online payments with deposits, and the tools to run every departure. No booking commission.

posts.name: Orwel
posts.tagline: Product analytics for builders and their AI agents
posts.description: Orwel turns loose clicks into people, intent and sales. One script identifies every visitor, scores who is ready to buy, maps journeys and feature adoption, ties each sale to its Google or Meta ad, and lets your AI agent query it all over MCP.

posts.name: ClarityVerify Reverse Phone Lookup
posts.tagline: Find caller names, addresses, and social profiles.
posts.description: ClarityVerify Reverse Phone Lookup helps users search phone numbers for available associated names, addresses, and other information.

posts.name: DearRewind
posts.tagline: Tell the story behind a song. Watch it play back. — DearMate
posts.description: One of the attractions at DearMate, a virtual AI theme park. Pick a song that takes you somewhere and tell the memory behind it in a one-minute interview. DearRewind turns it into a rewind: your story rising line by line, in time with the music, over film-like pictures. Then see where the same song took strangers.

posts.name: Tucki
posts.tagline: The proactive AI agent that builds family food habits
posts.description: Tucki is a proactive AI agent that changes how a whole household eats, not just one person. He learns your family's routines, plans the week, prices the shop across 6 UK supermarkets and steps in before good habits slip. Snap a plate to log it. Snap a receipt to see how much you're saving.

posts.name: Tiquiz
posts.tagline: AI quiz funnels that tag leads in Systeme.io & GoHighLevel
posts.description: Quiz builder that captures leads and sends them, with their result and their tag, to Systeme.io, GoHighLevel or any tool by webhook.

posts.name: ShotJar
posts.tagline: Screenshots stop vanishing into your Desktop
posts.description: ShotJar keeps recent screenshots on a shelf in your Mac's menu bar. Open it, grab a thumbnail, and drag the file into another app. Keep taking screenshots with macOS, CleanShot X or Shottr. Search by the text inside when you need it. Text recognition runs on your Mac.

posts.name: Univocal
posts.tagline: Mixed-language dictation + universal read-aloud for Mac
posts.description: Dictate naturally across languages and read along with anything you’re working on. Univocal handles mixed-language speech and brings selected or copied text into a universal reading panel, highlighting each word as it’s spoken. Read-aloud supports 32 languages. Speech processing stays on your Mac and works offline after setup. One-time purchase for up to three Macs. Try it free for 14 days, no card required. Apple silicon, macOS 14+.

posts.name: Wordmarks
posts.tagline: Preview Your Logo’s Text in 2,000+ Fonts
posts.description: Wordmarks shows your brand name beside your logo in 2,000+ fonts from Google Fonts, Fontshare and Fontsource, all at once. Drop in your logo, recolor it, pick a horizontal or stacked lockup, and tune weight, size and spacing across every font. Shortlist favorites or upload your own fonts, then copy as SVG or CSS, or download SVG, PNG or JPG. Free, no account, and everything stays in your browser.

posts.name: Reachy
posts.tagline: LinkedIn AI agent: from buying signal to booked call
posts.description: Reachy finds buyers from live LinkedIn signals (post reactions, events, groups, your website visitors), writes the outreach and answers every reply with your next step: a call, a trial, an interview. You approve each reply in one tap from Telegram, Slack, Discord, Claude or ChatGPT. AI included, runs from your own computer and LinkedIn account.

posts.name: TOPHEADS
posts.tagline: Executive Career Intelligence
posts.description: Executive career intelligence for senior leaders earning $150K+. Know what the market would pay you, track every conversation and offer in OTS, get 150+ matched roles in your first 24 hours, and publish an anonymous card when you're ready.

posts.name: Provantix
posts.tagline: Provantix is the telemetry layer for enterprise AI agents
posts.description: Agent telemetry, attribution, and audit evidence for enterprise AI. Signed event streams, identity binding from Entra ID and Microsoft 365, and exportable evidence with a verifiable chain of custody.

posts.name: Purrminal
posts.tagline: A focus timer for Windows where your work feeds tiny pets
posts.description: Focus timers count your minutes but give you no reason to come back tomorrow. Purrminal turns your workday into a small game. Start a focus round and your pet naps on your Windows taskbar. Finished focus earns coins for food, toys and 16 pets to collect, all free to earn. See who focused most this week in a private group with friends. Using Claude Code, OpenCode or Pi? Each session becomes a pet that asks before acting, so you stop juggling terminals. Free for Windows.

posts.name: Tidy My Mac
posts.tagline: Clean up your Mac
posts.description: Tidy My Mac clears junk, duplicates, similar photos and old apps' leftovers, and keeps your Mac safe with antivirus, ransomware and adware protection, a per-app firewall and Web Protection. Scans run on your Mac. 7 days free, then $19.99 for the first year.

posts.name: GoldenDoodle AI Writing Skills
posts.tagline: Your AI, your voice. GoldenDoodle keeps it that way.
posts.description: Three free, open-source skills for the AI you already use: human-centered language, trauma-informed language and human voice. In the public Benchmark (Nov 1, 2026 run), drafts that needed revision fell from 28 in 100 to 1 in 100 with the free standard.

posts.name: Ribbon Studio
posts.tagline: From artwork to interactive demos, with connected assets
posts.description: Create artwork, reusable components, screens, and interactive demos in one studio. Update a component once, and its blocks and screens update with it. Work visually, with the AI assistant, or with external agents via MCP, then export assets and source code.

posts.name: YojIQ
posts.tagline: Offline money planner: know what's safe to spend today
posts.description: YojIQ is an Android money planner for salaried people in India. It shows the money left till payday and a safe amount to spend today, splits your salary into Needs, Wants and Savings, and splits bills with flatmates and friends. Then it gives you a plan in order: emergency fund, health cover, term cover, then SIP. It has no internet permission: no sign-up, no bank linking, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your phone.

posts.name: Argus Agent Test Lab
posts.tagline: adversarial testing for AI agents that move money
posts.description: Independent adversarial testing lab for AI agents that move money — and the rails they settle on. Every verdict is an Ed25519-sealed record in a public hash chain.

posts.name: Capsulla
posts.tagline: Browser DLP for Google Workspace
posts.description: Capsulla is browser DLP for companies on Google Workspace. Write rules around the data your company needs to protect, from digital identifiers to contact details. Each rule blocks, masks, warns or just logs. Checks run in Chrome, so the data itself is never stored.
